name: Oniku Karyu
dinnerNoteJa: シェフおまかせコース（最安値）

menus.name: Seasonal omakase course
menus.note: Wagyu kaiseki for two or more; ¥34,100 to ¥39,600 by season, more when Tajima Kobe beef is served; tax included, plus 10% service

bookingOpens: Online through OMAKASE or TABLEALL, by phone, or through a hotel concierge. Bookings are for two or more.
cancellation: A table is cancelled automatically if guests are late without calling.
groups: Besides the eight-seat counter there are private rooms for four and for eight.
dressCode: Smart casual: no T-shirts, shorts or sandals.
children: Only children aged 6 and over in the private rooms.
byob: Corkage is ¥11,000 a bottle, tax included.
